title: HouseholdItem
description: One row of shared household data: exactly the fields of a HouseholdItem CloudKit record. Everything in the Household zone reaches every member, so only data a person chose to share belongs here. The record type never changes, so a new kind needs no CloudKit schema deployment.

id.description: Stable within its kind, usually the app's own UUID, so two devices write one row.

kind.description: <app>.<noun>, such as wildwood.staple. The named app defines the payload; any app in the household may read or write it.

payload.description: The kind's JSON object as text. Conflicts merge per top-level key.

updatedBy.description: A member id: the opaque CloudKit user record name in the household container, the same across apps and devices. Never an email or a phone number.

app.description: The app that wrote this revision.
